title: Chaos in the Order of Finite Bernoulli Convolutions
summary: In this note we explore numerically the finite Bernoulli convolutions. We show that with a suitable choice of parameter, it might serve as a toy model for intermittent energy cascade in fully developed turbulence. We then show how the crossings of $β$-expansions distribute in $β$, and suggest that it might highlight the parameters with enhanced overlap structure that are related to measures that are singular continuous.
